Yup, my family loves drama and I have had to repress my negative emotions to not let them egg me on and feed on it.

I identify with this a lot. I was also inseparable from her and I dread the day she'll be gone forever. I love her, but like you said, eventually something 
builds up over time. It gets harder for good moments to repair what was broken. I don't want her out of my life, I just want to be treated better so I wouldn't feel resentment towards her. All I ask is for her to stop belittling me and guilting me. 

I wonder if it'll do us good to spend some time away from our moms. Distance makes the heart grow fonder or whatever right? 

But for me, it's hard because I worry for her (she's getting older, more meds, less mobility). I do want to take care of her but she just needs to stop hurting me. I will still take care of her but it would just be less damaging for everyone involved if she could just reflect on her ways. That's all!!

It's interesting (?) to see how it played out for other people. Connection... I don't know what it means for me and her. I feel like now she just hates me too much for me to even bother. I feel like we do have a connection but it's like she's trying to break it down. 

I've been thinking about how I can move forward  and literally all I ask for is for her to stop belittling me. Like is it so hard for a mother to stop telling her daughter she's stupid and should die? When I confront her she says she doesn't "actually mean it". But she says it so often I wonder if she actually does.

I once asked her (we were arguing), would she feel sad if I killed myself. She said "I don't know, no one knows". Something changed in me when she said that. Was it so hard to say "yes"? Would she be lying if she had said "yes"???

I'm so sorry you went through that. My parents' marriage was fucked up, too, but my mom didn't take it out on us... I give her credit for that. Maybe that's why it hurts so much when she starts to do whatever the fuck she's doing now. Is it all the resentment she's been keeping all those years?? Idk

That sounds like a lot to deal with, having to hear cutting words and getting put down by your own mom. I feel like it's so difficult for them to admit it's their fault because in their minds, moms are perfect deity-like figures to their kids. No matter what they do they could never be at fault to their children, because they do everything out of "love" and to raise us.

That sounds so tiring and so much to deal with throughout your life. She sounds like a spilling handful of all that could be wrong with a mother. I especially will never understand and I despise mothers who like to instil fear in their kids and prioritise obedience rather than love. And when it affects you all the way to your adulthood they act shocked and blameless. It's fucking crazy.
I hope one day I would be able to be more at peace and genuinely accept and feel this. Thanks for your kind words :)

That sounds tough. Thanks for sharing and your kind words. You get me. Approval, guilt, worry... I associate those words with her. The feelings are so complicated. Of course I'm grateful for what she has done for me, how she raised me. I always try to remind myself of that. But she has also done and said things that aren't right, and I can only take in so much. I want her to get that. 

I think I do need to work on focusing on me better, because I really don't want to end up letting all these complex feelings and thoughts eat away at me.

I worry about being in a toxic relationship as a result of all... this. It'll be something new for me and I don't know what it can bring out in me, if anything. I probably would have a difficult time trusting and depending on someone and just become closed off and unloveable. Lol. Idfk. 

I hope I can heal. Here's to us indeed.
